sql:

  TYPEOF(NULL) AS A,
  TYPEOF('hello') AS B,
  TYPEOF(12+1) AS C,
  TYPEOF(4.7) AS D

SELECT
  TYPEOF(STRUCT<x INT64, y STRING>(25, 'apples')) AS struct_type,
  TYPEOF(STRUCT<x INT64, y STRING>(25, 'apples').y) AS field_type
